profile: Upstream Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for severe inflammatory respiratory diseases. Its lead candidate, verekitug, is a monoclonal antibody designed to block the receptor for thymic stromal lymphopoietin. The company plans to start Phase 3 trials in severe asthma and chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps in 2027, while a Phase 2 COPD trial continues. Patients with these conditions are its intended beneficiaries.
